subject: Warm intro + mutual action steps for TeleCare AWS listing
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@telecarehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Warm intro + mutual action steps for TeleCare AWS listing

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the quick call yesterday. As discussed, Redwood can help get TeleCare listed in the AWS Marketplace and enable a co-sell path with the AWS account team. To keep momentum, I pulled together a short mutual action plan and our marketplace onboarding checklist — attaching both.

Proposal: 30–45 min alignment call next week to confirm stakeholders, procurement timing, and AWS PM engagement. Suggested slots:
- Tue 9/22 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 9/23 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu 9/24 11:00–11:45 PT

Karthik, I’m looping you for co-sell logistics (pricing, partner referrals). Laura, please flag any security gating items we should surface to TeleCare before the call.

Key asks for the call:
- TeleCare primary stakeholders + procurement timeline
- Target go-live window for AWS listing and any launch incentives
- Any compliance paperwork (SOC2 / data residency) that needs to be prioritized

Attached: TeleCare_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (stub), redwood-aws-listing-checklist.xlsx (stub).

If those slots don’t work, Alex — tell me two that do and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior GTM Lead, AWS Marketplace
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

---
Attachment: TeleCare_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: redwood-aws-listing-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@telecarehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@telecarehealth.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@amazonaws.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Warm intro + mutual action steps for TeleCare AWS listing

Monica —

Appreciate the note and the materials. I’ve copied our procurement lead and Samir (AWS) so he’s in the loop. The proposed times look good; can we do Wed 9/23 at 14:00 PT? Procurement will join but may need to step out for a short window — procurement@telecarehealth.com should be available.

A couple quick context items so you’re prepared:
- Target: Beta launch behind customers by Nov 1; listing live in Marketplace by Nov 15 (ideal).
- Compliance: We have a SOC2 Type II report (expiry Jan 2027) and a data residency requirement for certain customers (US-only).
- Pricing: We’re expecting to discuss a blended ARR-based model; I’ll bring budget owners.

See you then — Alex

Sent from my iPhone
